description.en: Gives ball possession to a match member, looked up by team slot and character ID or number.
Index of the team/side the member belongs to.
Character ID string, or a numeric character index, identifying the member to give the ball to.
True once possession has been assigned; null if no teamSlot argument was given.

example.code:
// Give ball possession to a specific match member during a scripted sequence
CMND_BTL_SET_BALL_HAVE(1, "para_cp0149");
